retell: A chip company called AMD is paying about eight billion dollars for a start-up whose software makes virtual worlds to train robots.

problem: "an-thropic" is never introduced: a first-time viewer does not know it is an A I company, so "posed as an-thropic staff" means nothing to them.
fix: In security. Hackers posing as A I firm an-thropic's staff sent A I policy experts infected files. Researchers link the group to China's government.
